notes: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2025, labeled FY2025 as in the Toyota record because the 20-F uses only 'fiscal year ended March 31, 2025'; matches data.js fy 'Mar 2025'). Source: Form 20-F filed June 20, 2025 (accession 0001193125-25-143137) on www.sec.gov; IFRS, figures in billions of yen (JPY), no FX conversion. AKIO MORITA is deceased. The 20-F names no Morita family member, estate or foundation among major shareholders, so family is null. MAJOR SHAREHOLDERS: the 20-F lists Japanese Bulk Shareholding Reports filed with the Kanto Local Finance Bureau above 5%. Each percentage is as reported on that report's date, of total issued shares at that time; asOf is the report date. The reports don't say whether the holdings are direct or beneficial. The Sumitomo Mitsui Trust and Nomura share counts predate Sony's 5-for-1 stock split of October 1, 2024, and the Nomura report (October 2020) is stale. DIVIDENDS: the cash-flow line 'Dividends paid' (¥115,253m). The equity statement shows ¥115,312m declared to Sony Group stockholders (¥95 per share) and ¥7,704m to noncontrolling interests, so the cash-flow line appears to be the parent's dividends. BUYBACKS: 'Payments for purchases of treasury stock' (¥285,548m). GEOGRAPHY: sales by customer location, including financial services revenue (the 20-F still reports a Financial Services segment for this year).
